concept: Following the evidence even when it contradicts what you or your group believes
source_inspiration: original content, informed by Galileo's evidence-over-authority legacy — not sourced from any external text

exercise.scenario: Student encounters credible evidence that contradicts a belief widely held by their peer group
exercise.branching_choice: Student decides how to respond, both internally and if asked about it by friends
exercise.practice: Socratic follow-up on what makes this kind of situation genuinely hard, not just intellectually but socially

assessment.success_marker: student names the specific social cost of following evidence against the group, not just the abstract principle
